bookingSteps: Open the Book Appointment page from the top navigation.
Choose a doctor from the list (use Find a Doctor if you want to search first).
Pick a date - the clinic is closed on Sundays, so only open days are shown.
Pick an available time slot (slots already taken are greyed out).
Enter your name and email address, then review the summary.
Press Confirm Appointment and save the confirmation reference number.
emergency: If this is a medical emergency, call your local emergency number right away (911 in the United States) or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not wait for a chat reply.
disclaimer: MediConnect AI provides general health information only. It cannot diagnose a condition, prescribe medication or replace a qualified healthcare professional. Book an appointment for personal medical advice.
note: MediConnect AI is a demo project. Clinic details, doctors and appointments are sample data.
greeting: Hello! I am the MediConnect AI clinic assistant. I can answer questions about our clinic, services, doctor specialties and how to book an appointment. I cannot diagnose conditions or prescribe medication. What would you like to know?
fallback: I could not match that question to my clinic knowledge base. I can help with: clinic services, doctor specialties, opening hours, location, payments, telemedicine and the steps to book an appointment. For anything medical, please book an appointment with one of our doctors - and in an emergency call 911.

faqs.question: What services does the clinic offer?
faqs.answer: MediConnect AI offers general check-ups, cardiology, pediatrics, orthopedics, dermatology, neurology, gynecology, physiotherapy, telemedicine video visits and laboratory diagnostics. Which service are you interested in?

faqs.question: Which doctor specialties are available?
faqs.answer: Our doctors cover Cardiology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, Neurology, General Medicine, Gynecology and Physiotherapy. Visit the Find a Doctor page to search and filter the full directory.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Booking takes about a minute: open the Book Appointment page, choose a doctor, pick an open date and time slot, enter your name and email, then confirm. You will receive a confirmation reference number on screen. Would you like me to explain any step in more detail?

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Friday 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM, and closed on Sunday. Bookings can only be made for days when the clinic is open.

faqs.question: Where is the clinic located?
faqs.answer: Our demo clinic is at 100 Wellness Avenue, Suite 200, Springfield. You can reach us at +1 (555) 010-4200 or care@mediconnect-ai.demo.

faqs.question: What are the fees and payment options?
faqs.answer: Consultation fees are shown on each doctor's profile (sample values between $45 and $95 in this demo). We accept card, cash and most major insurance plans. Please confirm coverage with your insurer before your visit.

faqs.question: Do you offer online or video consultations?
faqs.answer: Yes - several of our doctors offer telemedicine video consultations. Select the Online Consultation option when you book, and a secure link is shown on your confirmation screen after booking.

faqs.question: How do I cancel or reschedule?
faqs.answer: Call +1 (555) 010-4200 or email care@mediconnect-ai.demo at least 4 hours before your slot and we will move or cancel it. In this demo, bookings are stored locally, so you can also simply book a new slot.

faqs.question: How do I find the right doctor?
faqs.answer: Use the Find a Doctor page: search by name or keyword, filter by specialty, and sort by rating or experience. Each profile shows experience, languages, availability and a short bio - clearly marked as demo data.

faqs.question: Can you diagnose my condition or give me medicine?
faqs.answer: No. I can only share general health information and clinic information - I cannot diagnose a condition, recommend medicine or replace a doctor. Please book an appointment with one of our physicians for personal medical advice.

faqs.question: Is this an emergency - what should I do?
faqs.answer: If this is a medical emergency, call your local emergency number right away (911 in the United States) or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not wait for a chat reply.

faqs.question: How is my data handled?
faqs.answer: This demo stores booking details only in your browser (localStorage) unless you connect your own Supabase project, where they are saved in your private database. Never enter real medical history - the form only asks for a name, email and slot.

faqs.question: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.answer: Bring a photo ID, your insurance card, a list of current medicines and any recent test reports. Arrive 10 minutes early so reception can complete your registration.

faqs.question: Do you provide lab tests and reports?
faqs.answer: Yes, our laboratory handles blood work, X-rays and basic imaging. Your doctor shares results through the patient portal, usually within 24-48 hours (sample turnaround for this demo).

faqs.question: How long will I have to wait?
faqs.answer: Appointments are scheduled every 30 minutes, so waiting times are usually short. Mornings are typically quieter than late afternoons if you prefer a faster visit.
